title: Adolescent reluctant to discuss vaping
opening: My mom made me come in. I don't even think I need to be here. I just have a cough.
goal: You are the clinician. Screen the cough, gently explore lifestyle factors, and help the teen feel safe being honest.

disclosures.response: The cough has been there for about three weeks. It's worst in the morning.
It's kind of dry and tickly. I keep clearing my throat.
I play basketball, and I've been getting winded way faster than usual.
Okay, fine... I've been vaping. Mostly with friends after school. I didn't want to say it in front of my mom.
Everyone on the team does it, so it didn't feel like a big deal.
Honestly, I do want to stop. I didn't know it could mess with my lungs like this.

metrics.name: Cough history
metrics.rationale: Characterizes how long the cough has lasted.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask when the cough started and how it has changed.

metrics.name: Cough characterization
metrics.rationale: Characterizes the quality of the cough.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask whether it is dry or productive, and what makes it worse.

metrics.name: Lifestyle exploration
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about vaping, smoking, or other exposures in a neutral way.

metrics.name: Non-judgmental rapport
metrics.rationale: Builds enough trust for the teen to disclose honestly.
metrics.coaching_hint: Make it safe to be honest: no lecture, no judgment, privacy.

metrics.name: Shared next step
metrics.rationale: Agrees on a concrete next step together.
metrics.coaching_hint: Agree a next step, like quit resources or a follow-up visit.
